TOP RISKS (ROADMAP.md)

Single-maintainer bus factor

Stated plainly; Apache-2.0 continuity path in CONTINUITY.md. The one gap engineering cannot close.

Upstream dependence

Native tier depends on Claude Code's LSP client and on PSES; this project can file against both, fix neither. #86936 is the live instance.

Wrong > missing

A wrong finding costs more than a missing one. Every broadening is gated on the corpus FP bar, recomputed every CI run -- defaults stay narrow.

Documentation drift

Mitigated structurally: knob table, frozen-knob contract, and manifest are set-equality guarded in CI. Drift is a red build, not a stale doc.
